config_dir.description: The directory to look for existing Incus configuration. (default = $HOME/.config/incus)

default_remote.description: The default remote to use when no other remote is defined in a resource.

generate_client_certificates.description: Automatically generate the Incus client certificates if they don't exist.

address.description: The URL of the Incus host. Multiple addresses can be provided as a comma-separated string. The default will be the path to the local unix socket, or leaving it as an empty string will use the default socket path.

authentication_type.description: Server authentication type, tls or oidc. ( Only for the `incus` protocol )

credentials_helper.description: Credential helper executable for OCI registry authentication. ( Only for the `oci` protocol )

protocol.description: Server protocol ( incus, oci or simplestreams )

token.description: The trust token used for initial authentication with the Incus remote.

description.description: The description for the image alias.

name.description: The name of the image alias.

block.description: Wait for instance to be ready

target_address.description: Target address to forward listen port to

target_port.description: Target port to forward listen port to
